question:
Identify the figure given in the options, which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/335a1fcf130517bb292cacf3ec0bad611e81b935e6eb26e536bcf998ffbd408f.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Pattern: Letter A moves counterclockwise and its water image changes in every step.

Letter P moves in an anticlockwise direction and its mirror image changes in every step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49cb13f29fb38f679228db46dd3f938930e667f2e477b6c5ba266e081b8ab741.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
